newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peking Apparel IPO 130.21 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Peking Apparel IPO 130.21 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Hong Kong leather garments manufacturer and distributor Peking Apparel International Group Ltd said on Tuesday its public share offer of 64.75 million new shares at HK$1.0 per share was 130.21 times oversubscribed.
It said in a statement that it received applications for some 7.65 billion shares, including warrants.
The shares were offered with warrants in the proportion of one warrant for every five shares subscribed.
It said earlier the issue price represented a price earnings ratio of 5.7 times on a weighted average basis and 6.8 times on a proforma fully diluted basis.
Dealing in the shares is expected to commence on March 7.
